title: Petra and the Salt
author: I. M. Dunmore
blurb: August Villalobos, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
